title: Settle the flash/full boundary: run one epic with [tier_policy] classification routing ON and re-tune mass_threshold
body: wne proved the classification mechanism but not the boundary: the 0.50 mass threshold and construction's side of the flash/full line rest on a 49-tick sample that ran with no tier_policy, where every retry was a wall-clock or hold failure. Run one epic with dear_work_types/dear_tier/mass_threshold declared and a real classifier wired, count flash-start failures that pass on the next rung as capability failures, and re-tune the threshold against that run's recorded distributions. Depends on the credential decision (c6f918cc) and on fixing first-dispatch-only classification (c0102b2d) and concurrency sizing (df6304e5); declaring the cells spends money, so the operator must approve it.
